overall: The AG found the Committee violated the Open Meeting Law by proceeding with its April 12 meeting after technical failures stopped real-time broadcast, declined the requested re-vote, and ordered future compliance.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged that part of the April 12 meeting was not accessible to the public after the livestream and broadcast failed.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the Committee violated the Open Meeting Law on April 12 when, despite learning that technical problems prevented the meeting from being streamed or broadcast live, the Committee proceeded with the meeting.

remedy: We order the Committee’s immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law and note that future similar violations may be considered evidence of an intent to violate the law.
